svg.text: One lap, deployed policy, coloured by speed — speed-capped at 13 m/s
The car drove all 6,999 m of Spa without leaving the road. Cool is slow, warm is fast — but the whole lap spans
only 13.0–14.7 m/s, because a 13 m/s limiter is holding it back. This is a clean lap, not a fast one.
[MEASURED] curr_ct2_policy.pt, deployed (mean-action) policy, speed_cap 13 m/s (the cap the checkpoint was selected under),
cross_track_penalty 2, Spa via tracks_data.load_real_track, offset-free tire. Rung 2 of the fidelity ladder (double-track): per-wheel loads
and load transfer, no roll camber, roll steer or compliance.
